implementation_policy_scope: PD versus controls; T1/T2/T3 tiers; cross-site and within-site AUROC weighted equally; nested inner selection, locked outer evaluation; Turku (OSF pehj9) one-shot locked-site evaluation
hardware: Apple M4, 16 GB unified memory; CPU/MPS only; no cloud

session_count_confound.note: v3's UCSD/New Mexico session-count confound (metadata AUROC 1.000; PD had repeated medication sessions, controls one) is eliminated by construction under A1: every supervised person now has exactly one session, so session count carries zero information and cannot achieve any AUROC above chance.

pre_declared.note: Every other variant is descriptive, not a pre-declared result.

G2_b_features_add_over_v3_rich.verdict: NOT MET on corrected data: best B family exceeds the recomputed v3-rich baseline by 0.0068 (<0.02). H2 unsupported.

G3_transductive_gain_and_stress_test.verdict: NOT MET on gain: S|T improves cross-site by 0.007 (<0.02). H3 unsupported.

H1_vs_v3_predeclared.caveat: Cohort (324 vs 440), QC and features differ; not an architecture-only comparison.

correction_effect.note: Only F4 and F5 changed; both consume the corrected preref128/lpc arrays. F0/F1/F2/F3/F6 are identical to 3dp because they derive from the filtered+referenced tokens/cov, untouched by the fix.
correction_effect.hypothesis_outcome: The prediction that the unfiltered-LPC bug explained F4/LEAPD s poor result was WRONG: F4 got slightly worse. F5 improved markedly (+0.049).

H5_locked_site_turku.requirement: 95% CI lower bound of the primary pipeline above 0.60
H5_locked_site_turku.verdict: FAILS decisively on both runs. CI lower bound 0.280 (n=20) and 0.301 (n=24), far below the required 0.60; both intervals span chance. The model does not demonstrably generalise to Turku.
H5_locked_site_turku.robustness: The ID-matching bug changed the point estimate (0.570 -> 0.545) but not the conclusion.

harmonisation.aggregation_rule: majority of outer sites (>=3 of 4); 2 of 4 is a tie, not a majority

permutation_null.note: Labels permuted within site; a real signal must sit far above this.

negative_controls.note: Recording-metadata control is covered by cohort_v4.confound_audit: A1 makes session count constant, so it carries no information by construction.

G6.note: Montages re-referenced to their own channels only; no 17-channel information enters.

skipped.labram: BSD-3-Clause, but the checkpoint's temporal_embedding [1,16,200] does not match the 4 s window v4's protocol fixes.
skipped.reve: Licence declared only as 'other'; companion reve-positions declares none. Skipped under the protocol's unclear-licence rule.

foundation_models.caveat: The pooled embedding is 27,200-dimensional for 324 people, so the linear probe is in a severe p>>n regime even at C=0.1. A weak probe result cannot be cleanly separated from that.

naive_bayes_overcounting.note: Adding a near-duplicate modality inflates the combined evidence almost as much as adding a genuinely independent one, although it carries little new information. That gap is the over-counting.

test_retest.scorer: F0 rich-SVM trained on the three non-Iowa sites; neither session of a scored person is in training.
test_retest.caveat: n=18 people. An ICC on this few subjects has a wide confidence interval and should be read as indicative only.

P3.selection_note: P3 fixed to M4T by reviewed decision as the wearable form factor of interest, NOT chosen on any score. M5S scored marginally higher on outer composite and was deliberately not used.

coverage.note: QC exclusions were determined label-free, before any label was opened: 13 recordings produced no accepted window and 3 fell below A2's 10-window minimum.

format_verification.note: Raw unprocessed .set; amplitude/QC not evaluated here (Stage 4).

qc_label_free.note: Label-free: acceptance counts only, no PD/control breakdown (labels sealed).

decision_rule.caveat: Turku-EO is itself near chance (0.545), so a small delta can mean 'both near 0.5 for different reasons'; the rule was fixed before the numbers existed and is applied as written.

coverage.note: QC/A2 decided label-free before labels were opened; exclusions are cross-tabulated by diagnosis only here.

results.condition_caveat: BrainLat is eyes-closed; training and Turku are eyes-open. Interpret only through the Turku-EC control verdict (turku-eyesclosed-control.json).

inspection.purpose: Does preprocessing track diagnosis? Naming classes by group/site and label-free processing signatures of one flagged + one plain file per group.
inspection.note: Subject identities of the sampled files are deliberately not recorded.
